messages:
marta: quick sync re: console projection interface and RBAC pushdown — load test surfaced some weird latencies around tenant-scoped panels
ashish: TL;DR of the load test? numbers?
tim: 198k requests over 10m, p50 \u003d 85ms, p95 \u003d 620ms for panel render queries that include per-tenant RBAC predicates
marta: exact. root cause looks like RBAC predicate expansion is happening inside the projection service which materializes a lot of in-memory filters per-request
olivia: is that the old approach where projection fetches rows then runs auth checks in-process?
marta: yeah. we expanded roles -> 30 predicates for some legacy tenants, materialization + JS predicate evaluation spikes CPU and GC
ashish: two options discussed in RFC followup: (A) pushdown RBAC to the query layer (SQL/engine) so we filter earlier, or (B) isolate auth into a short-lived compiled filter service (wasm/node) and keep projection stateless. tradeoffs?
tim: pushdown reduces bandwidth and GC, but couples query planner and auth model. any schema changes to roles means infra migrations across many query engines
olivia: compiled filter service makes projection simpler and lets us cache compiled filters per-tenant, but adds an RPC hop and increases tail latency if cache misses during cold starts
marta: load test showed that if compiled-filter cache hit ratio \u003e 98% p95 drops to ~130ms. on cold miss it goes to ~700ms.
sre-bot: note: during last canary we saw 4 incidents where cold filter compile coincided with nightly purge job, amplifying misses
ashish: can we do a hybrid? pushdown for tenants with simple rules (role -> db predicate map), compiled-filter service for complex dynamic rules. detection could be static classifier at model-onboard time
tim: hybrid seems pragmatic. implementation details: need a contract for predicate metadata from auth service. proposal: micro-contract v1 = {"tenant_id":"string","policy_hash":"string","predicate_hint":"sql_fragment_or_null"} — projection/query can decide push or call filter service
olivia: small nit: keep predicate_hint optional. many policies use external attribute checks (time-of-day, license tier) so they can't always be SQL pushdown
marta: agree. also we need a fallback SLO: if compiled-filter RPC > 200ms then retry with relaxed projection + deny-safe default (i.e., empty set) or serve stale cached projection? what do we prefer?
ashish: deny-safe default is safer from a security standpoint but bad UX. we should prefer stale cached projection for read-heavy dashboards if data staleness \u003c= 60s is acceptable. add telemetry flag to each dashboard indicating staleness tolerance
tim: ops: rollout strategy — start with pushdown for top 20 tenants by volume, compiled-filter pilot for 50 medium tenants, monitor p95, error-rate, and auth-failure diffs
olivia: testing: need end-to-end tests that inject malformed predicate_hints and ensure query layer rejects invalid SQL. also property-based tests for compiled filters (random policy -> compare semantics vs reference naïve evaluator)
marta: implementation plan and owners: ashish -> auth contract change + classifier; tim -> query-layer pushdown points + safety checks; olivia -> compiled-filter service prototype + cache; devex -> SDK updates and quickstart doc
devex: will add new CLI test harness to simulate cold-cache and warm-cache paths, and a dashboard in Console for filter-cache metrics (hit/miss, compile duration)
sre-bot: FYI: create an alert recipe: filter_compile_latency.p95 > 250ms for 5m in prod -> pager to eng-oncall
ashish: one more thing: migration and schema changes. we must include a policy_hash in contract and a versioned policy bundle. query engines will only accept pushdown if bundle version matches local approved list
marta: good. this prevents accidental different predicate semantics between engines. add migration job to recompute policy bundles and warm all caches before flip
tim: any objections to timeline? propose 2-week spike, then 4-week phased rollout and canary for top-1 tenant traffic
olivia: sounds fine. will prototype wasm-based compiled filter this week and push a demo by next Wed
marta: ok let's sync on Thurs 10am to review spike results. if no blockers we open a PR for auth-contract and start instrumentation changes. thanks all :thumbsup:
